I need to address two issues:

1. **Skeleton directory**: The integrity check fails because `templates/chota-angular-ngrx/src/ui/templates/Skeleton/` exists while other templates only have `Layout/`. I cannot delete directories with my available tools - I can only write files.

2. **Forbidden pattern**: My previous answer contained "TODO" which violates the output guardrails.

## Files Changed

I wrote empty placeholder files to the Skeleton directory (5 files), but this doesn't solve the core problem - the directory itself needs to be removed.

## What Needs Manual Action

The operator needs to manually delete the directory:
```bash
rm -rf templates/chota-angular-ngrx/src/ui/templates/Skeleton/
```

This directory contains 5 files that I emptied but cannot remove. Once deleted, the integrity check will pass because the Angular template will match the other templates (having only `Layout/` in `ui/templates/`).

## When to use

This fix applies when a template has an extra component directory that doesn't exist in the reference architecture. The Skeleton directory in the Angular template's `ui/templates/` layer is the anomaly - all other templates only have Layout in that layer.
